A1.justification: Both PDFs describe FAN with the same central architecture and retained experiments. Their text, equations, figures, tables and appendices support a reliable comparison despite substantial additions and reorganization in v3.

before.justification: V2 reports original periodic-function fitting, symbolic representation, forecasting, sentiment classification and image-recognition experiments, including appendix results.

after.justification: V3 retains original empirical results and adds Fourier-network comparisons, scaling experiments, runtime measurements, Burgers-equation results and additional analyses.

M1.justification: The core FAN equations and gated variant are unchanged. However, v3 introduces residual connections for the new depth-study adaptation in Appendix B.5. Applying FAN to FNO and FEDformer otherwise reuses the existing layer-substitution approach.

E1.justification: V3 adds Burgers-equation scientific machine learning and Electricity forecasting in Appendices B.2 and B.6. It also reports LLM scaling experiments, although their corpus is unspecified. The image benchmarks and their OOD pairings already appeared in v2's appendix.

E2.justification: V3 adds evaluated FNN, FSNN and FTNN comparisons, a fixed-frequency coefficient-learning baseline, and comparisons against FNO and FEDformer. FEDformer's baseline scores are explicitly attributed to its paper. CNN and Snake comparisons were already present in v2.

E3.justification: New protocols include 268M-6.7B model scaling, evaluation every 20B tokens up to 200B, Burgers resolutions from 256 to 8192, and depth and periodic-width sweeps. The stated general depth range changes from 3-12 to 3-24 layers. These additions do not establish that retained experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: V3 adds fixed-frequency ablation, periodic-width sensitivity and network-depth analyses in Appendices B.3-B.5, alongside Fourier-alternative, scaling and runtime analyses in Section 3.3. These test architectural choices and practical scaling behavior. The earlier Snake and instance-normalization analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version specifies repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals, significance tests or uncertainty bands. V3's additional results continue reporting point values and curves without introducing uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: V3 adds substantial comparison, scaling, runtime, PDE and ablation results. FAN's reported Exchange-720 MSE/MAE changes from 2.063/1.205 in v2 Table 2 to 1.857/1.145 in v3 Table 7, changing overall averages from 0.852/0.635 to 0.839/0.631. Final-epoch vision results are removed; retained best-epoch vision, sentiment and instance-normalized forecasting scores match.

T1.justification: Appendix E adds a brief universal-approximation argument using stated activation-function conditions; v2 only asserted this property. Section 3 also introduces the zero-frequency MLP special-case argument. The principal Fourier derivation remains unchanged, and the additions do not constitute a detailed formal proof.

C1.justification: V2 leaves larger-scale modeling to future work; v3 explicitly claims more favorable LLM scaling and parameter/token efficiency. It also promotes image recognition into the abstract, introduction and conclusion, and makes the distinction from task-specific Fourier networks central to its claimed contribution.

C2.justification: V3 adds interpretations of fixed-frequency mismatch, FTNN's periodicity failures, task-dependent periodic-width optima and depth/scaling behavior. Runtime discussion introduces a practical qualification absent from v2: MLP is faster for small layers, while FAN benefits at larger dimensions.

D1.justification: The hardware description changes from one to eight A100-40GB GPUs. V3 also specifies residual connections for the depth study and identifies OLMo as the scaling reference configuration. Existing task implementation details and code-access information are largely retained; the new scaling corpus and detailed training recipe remain unspecified.

R1.justification: V3 expands positioning around Fourier-activation, Fourier-series and Fourier-transform networks and connects these distinctions to direct comparisons. Added references include SIREN, FNet, earlier Fourier-series networks, OLMo, scaling laws and FEDformer. Two Zuo 2008 works are removed.

P1.justification: V3 substantially rewrites the abstract and introduction, groups application experiments within Section 3.2, introduces Further Analysis in Section 3.3, and relocates baseline descriptions and general implementation information to appendices. These are extensive narrative and structural changes beyond merely adding experiments.

P2.justification: V3 replaces the main forecasting table with an average-results summary and moves detailed results to Table 7. It relocates and combines periodicity panels, moves and simplifies the image table, and adds several analysis figures and tables. Original plots are retained despite their changed placement.

improvement.justification: V3 substantially strengthens evidence for FAN's architectural rationale: Figure 6/Table 5 directly compare Fourier alternatives, while Appendices B.3-B.5 test frequency learning, width and depth, addressing important experimental gaps in v2. Runtime measurements also qualify the efficiency claim. These targeted gains outweigh reduced transparency from removing final-epoch vision results and their best-versus-final distinction, although missing scaling data and training details limit assessment of the new scaling claims.
